title: 第26章 我需要两位帮个忙第27章 生死战妖兽
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 立刻盘膝而坐，苏辰没有丝毫地浪费时间。
体內开始运转混沌吞噬诀，浩瀚吞噬顺势吞噬整个地面，一股股的力量源源不断地涌入身体每一处，好像沐浴在阳光下，很是舒服。
有些疼痛，毕竟吞噬得太快，对於自身的超负荷炼化融合，会有很大的麻烦。
苏辰却管不了那么多，毕竟他需要趁著力量还未消散之前，吞噬完这里的力量，才能够顺利衝击到九级筑基境。
浩瀚磅礴的力量涌入体內，犹如洪水猛兽一样，狠狠地肆虐著身体每一处，並且在他的血轮开始匯聚。
取出一枚盘血灵芝，苏辰已经等不到炼製盘血丹，他现在急需吞噬盘血灵芝，来提升灵魂等级。
盘血灵芝入口即化，顺著喉咙瞬间涌入体內。
幸亏有著混沌吞噬诀，要是换做其他人，根本不敢疯狂地吞噬如此庞大力量，一旦失手，后果不堪设想。
就在此时。
苏辰发现，一直陷入沉睡的紫狐，正在慢慢地吞噬著自己身边的力量。
从空间戒指內取出三株盘血灵芝，小心翼翼地给紫狐吞服。
接著藉助体內运转的混沌吞噬诀，將炼化的力量，源源不断地给紫狐送入体內，相信双管齐下，紫狐的伤势应该可以彻底稳定下来。
不得不说。
混沌吞噬诀的確很霸道，如此高运转的吞噬下，地面的力量只是流逝了三分之一，剩下的三分之二，被全部吞噬得乾乾净净。
藉助吞噬的力量，苏辰不仅仅突破到九级筑基境，更是达到了巔峰筑基境，距离虚丹境也只是相差一步而已。
砰！
就在此时。
石晨和萧鸣终於在步步惊险中，顺利斩杀血魔虎，不过两人的伤势也非常严重，喘著粗气，看著面前已经不见的所有盘血灵芝。
真是够狠的。
连一株盘血灵芝都没有给他们留下。
並且此人还坐在这里修炼，吞吸盘血灵芝留下的力量。
不等两人说话。
苏辰的身影犹如鬼魅般，瞬间来到血魔虎面前，眼神有些贪婪，巔峰虚丹境妖兽的灵魂很是不错，绝对是大补品。
刚刚吞噬的速度太快了，庞大的力量让他的境界不稳定，急需要吞噬妖兽灵魂来中和，彻底稳定境界。
没有丝毫的迟疑和磨嘰。
体內开始运转混沌吞噬诀，手掌覆盖在尸体的头部。
在混沌吞噬诀的覆盖下，血魔虎体內的力量，开始顺著苏辰的手掌不断地涌入体內。
『他在做什么？』
“小子，我们拼死联手斩杀血魔虎，你却在这里捡便宜，是不是不太合理。”
“交出所有的盘血灵芝。”
“你可以留下一株。”
content_en:
Su Chen immediately sat cross-legged, without wasting any time.
The Chaos Swallowing Technique began to operate in the body, and the vast swallowing swallowed the entire ground. A steady stream of power poured into every part of the body, as if bathing in the sun, very comfortable.
Some pain, after all, is swallowed up too quickly, which will cause great trouble for one's own overloaded refining and fusion.
Su Chen couldn't control that much, after all, he needed to devour the power here before the power dissipated, so that he could successfully reach the ninth level of foundation building.
Vast and majestic power poured into his body, like a scourge, ravaging every part of his body, and began to gather in his blood chakra.
After taking out a Pan-blood Ganoderma lucidum, Su Chen could no longer wait to refine the Pan-blood Ganoderma. He now urgently needed to devour the Pan-blood Ganoderma to increase his soul level.
Panxue Ganoderma melts in the mouth and pours into the body instantly along the throat.
Thanks to the Chaos Devouring Technique, if it were anyone else, they would not dare to madly devour such a huge power. Once they failed, the consequences would be disastrous.
"Huh?"
Right now.
Su Chen discovered that the purple fox, which had been sleeping, was slowly devouring the power around him.
He took out three blood-coated Ganoderma lucidum plants from the space ring and carefully gave them to Zihu to swallow.
Then, with the help of the Chaos Devouring Technique running in the body, the refined power is continuously fed into Zihu's body. I believe that with a two-pronged approach, Zihu's injury should be completely stabilized.
I have to say.
The Chaos Devouring Technique is indeed very overbearing. Under such high-speed devouring, only one-third of the power on the ground is lost, and the remaining two-thirds are completely devoured.
With the help of the power of devouring, Su Chen not only broke through to the ninth-level foundation-building realm, but also reached the peak foundation-building realm, which was only one step away from the virtual core realm.
Bang!
Right now.
Shi Chen and Xiao Ming finally managed to kill the Blood Demon Tiger successfully in every step of danger, but their injuries were also very serious. They gasped and looked at all the blood-coated Ganoderma lucidum that had disappeared in front of them.
It's really cruel.
Not even a single plant of Panxue Ganoderma was left to them.
And this person is still sitting here cultivating, swallowing the power left behind by the sucker blood Ganoderma lucidum.
Without waiting for the two to speak.
Su Chen's figure was like a ghost, and he came to the Blood Demon Tiger in an instant, with greedy eyes. The soul of the peak Void Core Realm monster was very good, and it was definitely a great tonic.
The speed he just swallowed was too fast, and the huge power made his realm unstable. He urgently needed to swallow the soul of the monster to neutralize it and completely stabilize his realm.
There was no hesitation or hesitation at all.
The Chaos Devouring Technique began to operate within his body, and his palms covered the corpse's head.
Under the cover of the Chaos Devouring Technique, the power in the Blood Demon Tiger's body began to flow into the body along Su Chen's palm.
"What is he doing?" 』
"Boy, we are working together to kill the Blood Demon Tiger, but you are here to take advantage. Isn't it unreasonable?"
"Hand over all the Panxue Ganoderma."
"You can keep one."
